validated_results.journal: Cancer epidemiology, biomarkers & prevention : a publication of the American Association for Cancer Research, cosponsored by the American Society of Preventive Oncology
validated_results.reason: Prospective case-cohort analysis within the Netherlands Cohort Study reporting incidence rate ratios for baseline toenail selenium and incident prostate carcinoma.

extraction.comparison_type: highest versus lowest quintile of toenail selenium
extraction.population: Men aged 55-69 years at entry in the Netherlands Cohort Study

sample_size.excerpt: The association between prostate cancer and baseline toenail selenium level was evaluated in the Netherlands Cohort Study, conducted among 58,279 men, aged 55-69 years at entry.

cases.excerpt: After 6.3 years of follow-up, 540 incident prostate carcinoma cases and 1,211 subcohort members with complete toenail selenium data were available for case-cohort analyses.

effect_size.excerpt: Incidence rate ratios in increasing selenium quintiles were 1.00 (ref), 1.05, 0.69, 0.75, and 0.69 (95% confidence interval, 0.48-0.99), respectively (P-trend=0.008). This association persisted after exclusion of cases diagnosed during early follow-up.

confidence_interval.excerpt: Incidence rate ratios in increasing selenium quintiles were 1.00 (ref), 1.05, 0.69, 0.75, and 0.69 (95% confidence interval, 0.48-0.99), respectively (P-trend=0.008).
